# pvecli vm tag

Manage VM tags.

## add

Add one or more tags to a VM.

By default, tags are appended to existing tags.
Use --replace to replace all existing tags.

```text
pvecli vm tag add [VMID] [TAGS] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `VMID` | VM ID. |
| `TAGS` | Tag(s) to add (comma-separated). |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-re`, `--replace` | Replace all existing tags instead of appending. |

## remove

Remove one or more tags from a VM.

```text
pvecli vm tag remove [VMID] [TAGS] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `VMID` | VM ID. |
| `TAGS` | Tag(s) to remove (comma-separated). |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |

## list

List all tags for a VM.

```text
pvecli vm tag list [VMID] [OPTIONS]
```

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `VMID` | VM ID. |

### Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
